{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Confirm only two channels exist
print("Channels in data:")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.loc[revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].idxmax()]['channel']
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].max()

print(f"Channel with most revenue: {max_channel} with {max_revenue:.2f} USD")"}
